cover: Enterprise architecture diagram on deep Salesforce navy (#032D60) background with subtle dot-grid. Subtitle in white: 'Technical debt remediation control plane for metadata, automation, data, security, and integrations'. Top-right: circular avatar badge 'Bennie Joseph | Architect'. BOTTOM LAYER 'Governance Guardrails' vivid teal/green border — modules 'Ownership Registry', 'Release Gates', 'Deletion Backlog' as bright white pills. RIGHT PANEL orange border: 'MuleSoft APIs' and 'Agentforce 2.0 Ops Assistant'. High contrast, sharp rendering, publication-ready.
